description: The Darkreaver Menace Level 60 Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him. Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar. Requirements: - Darkreaver's Head
name: The Darkreaver Menace
